chunks.text: Ma3ak is WE's customer support service for the deaf and mute. A specialized team will attend to all your inquiries using sign language over a video call on Te.eg. Before using Ma3ak service, please ensure the following: - Allow your browser to access the camera and mic during the video call. - You are using one of the supported browsers, which are: Android (Chrome, Firefox), iPhone (Safari), PC (Chrome, Firefox). - You have a strong, stable internet connection to ensure high quality service. - The working hours is from 9 Am to 9 Pm. The page also lists stores that provide sign language service by governorate.
